task.name: Independent development validation of a serial multi-segment soft arm
task.source: Development task with fixed target, tolerance and scoring; historical tasks are unchanged

environment.gravity_source: main@245a785 reach_free environment; Human-owned benchmark gravity

assumptions: Serial double-bending cells, separate structure/discretization, SI
